verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents multiple ways to drive it programmatically: the Agent SDK for building custom agents on top of its tools/orchestration, direct ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-based API access, a scriptable CLI, and an MCP server mode (`claude mcp serve`) confirmed to work by a local probe. This covers documented, public, non-UI interfaces for AI-native automation. Missing for 10: a full formal API/reference spec (endpoints/schemas) beyond SDK/CLI docs, and independent third-party corroboration of programmatic API usage beyond Anthropic's own docs and one CLI probe.
